title: Zesty Creamy Russian Lentil Stew
description: A spicy, creamy stew with lentils, vegetables, and a smooth roux, served lazy-sunday style in a Talavera plate.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp butter in a large pot over medium heat until foamy.
Whisk in 2 tbsp flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, to make a roux.
Add diced onion, carrots, and minced garlic to the pot, sautéing until vegetables soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, ground cumin, ground coriander and cayenne pepper, cooking for another minute to bloom the spices.
Pour in 4 cups vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a gentle boil.
Rinse 1 cup of green lentils, then add them to the pot, reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes, or until lentils are tender.
Once lentils are cooked, stir in 1 cup heavy cream and season with salt and pepper to taste, simmer for an additional 5 minutes until creamy.
Adjust thickness by whisking in a small amount of flour if needed, then ladle the stew into a Talavera plate.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh dill if desired.
